notes.title: Greetings Voyagers! - Summer Update 1
notes.content:
Greetings Voyagers!

We’re excited to bring you a substantial update to Voids Adrift®, packed with new features and enhancements to make your adventures across the Void even more immersive and thrilling.

🌟 New Feature: Island Designer 🌟
We're thrilled to introduce the Island Designer, a powerful tool that lets you unleash your creativity and design your very own unique islands. Originally crafted as an in-house developer tool, we’re now sharing it with our community so you can showcase your talent. Your islands might even make it into the final game, becoming a part of the world thousands of players will explore!

Whether you envision open cities, lush jungle habitats, or secretive pirate hideouts, the Island Designer empowers you to bring your ideas to life. Dive in, experiment, and create stories perfect for others to discover!

🔧 Enhanced Object Editor 🔧
Alongside the Island Designer, we’ve rolled out an updated version of the Object Editor. This enhanced toolset offers more functionality and intuitive controls, allowing you to customize and populate your islands with even more precision and creativity.

⚡ Performance Improvements ⚡
We've heard your feedback and have made significant improvements to the game's performance. Expect a faster, more responsive experience as you traverse the realms and engage in epic battles or peaceful trading missions.

🛠️ Ongoing Bug Fixes and Future Updates 🛠️
While this update brings a lot of exciting features, we’re aware there are still a few bugs to iron out. Rest assured, none of these are major issues and our team is hard at work to address them. Additionally, we’ll be adding more objects and customization options in the coming days, so stay tuned!

🌐 New Language Settings 🌐
To make Voids Adrift even more accessible, we've added new language settings. You can now enjoy the game in a variety of languages, making it easier for our global community to immerse themselves in the adventure.

Thank you for being a part of the Voids Adrift community. We can’t wait to see the incredible islands you create and hear your feedback on the new tools and improvements.

Happy exploring!

The Voids Adrift Team
